messages.subject: R version for tRophicPosition
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

We have some problem to install the tRophicPosition package on my computer (Windows 10).

We would like to know which R version for Windows is used to run the tRophicPosition package ?

We have seen that the version 3.6.0 is available in April.... but can we used another version ?

Thank you for your help and for this interesting work,

Best regards,

Guillaume Marchessaux & Mélanie Ourgaud
